name: adsb.lol around Heathrow, Gatwick, London City, Stansted and Luton
gives: airline flights within a radius of each London airport (callsign, type, altitude, speed, heading)

why.quote: the API is available to everyone. license: ODbL 1.0. [...] limits no key: 500 requests/day per IP.

interface: REST JSON, point and radius query, as sources/adsb-faro does for Faro.
notes: ODbL needs attribution and share-alike on a derived database; same privacy rule as adsb-faro (no hex id or position of a private aircraft). Five airports is five requests a run against a 500 a day per IP limit with no key: to be checked before an hourly run. Update 18 Nov 2026: the keyless adsb.lol read that exists is sources/adsb-london-portugal (positions around Faro, Lisbon and Porto, route lookup to tie flights to the five London airports; 4 requests a run). This entry (positions around the London airports) stays not collected. A collector for the London to Faro, Lisbon and Porto routes is written (on-hold/adsb-london-portugal) and waits for adsb.lol's route lookup, which returned no routes on 18 Nov 2026.
how: Not collected yet. Decision by Dinis, 18 Nov 2026 about 22:20 UTC (PrompTugal__News__Website board/guidance/2026-11-18-london.md): London is the first place beyond Portugal; each UK source goes on the register with its terms read first, then is collected to the pipeline standard.
